newsitem.title: USA: Fleetwood Q4 sales fall three pct.
newsitem.headline: Fleetwood Q4 sales fall three pct.

text.p: Fleetwood Enterprises Inc, which produces manufactured housing and recreational vehicles, said Wednesday that preliminary figures show fiscal fourth quarter sales declined three percent, to $746 million from $772 million a year earlier.
The company cited lower manufactured housing volume for the decline.

For the full year, ended April 27, consolidated sales reached a record $2.87 billion, two percent ahead of the previous year's $2.81 billion, on the strength of higher recreational vehicle sales, it said.
Final sales and earnings figures for the quarter and year will be announced in about four weeks.
